purpose: Fix pilot for the measured motion collapse, following ARDY's design: extend the teacher-forced history from 1.0 s to 2.4 s (12 latent blocks) so a resting context can carry the evidence of whether the clip's action has already happened. Everything else matches the plain start-aligned H8 2k control.

frozen_model.backbone: full spatiotemporal DiT with signed local temporal and spatial 3D RoPE
frozen_model.teacher_forcing: clean ground-truth history during training; generated history during rollout

validation.claim_limit: A two-thousand-step single-seed pilot diagnoses motion onset; it is not a final architecture ranking.
